tree.className: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-6xl flex-col gap-6 px-6

tree: Twinlink, the Paris-founded enterprise AI company specializing in computer-use agents, today announced that its agentic platform is now available on the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, an independent cloud located entirely within the European Union.

The deployment gives European organizations, from regulated industries to the public sector, access to advanced AI agents while keeping customer-created content and customer metadata within the EU. In practice, this means Twinlink runs its EU customer inference on NVIDIA-powered instances within the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, while continuing to train its models on AWS infrastructure globally.

The announcement builds on longstanding joint innovation between AWS and NVIDIA, including plans to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra NVIDIA GPUs across AWS global infrastructure in 2027 and 2028 to meet surging demand for AI compute.

Twinlink builds AI agents that use software the way people do: they click, type, and navigate on screen, working directly with the legacy systems that European organisations rely on, without API integrations or changes to the systems underneath. Running these agents means processing an organization's live data, so where that data sits and who controls it is critical. On the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, all customer content and customer-created metadata stay within the EU.

The infrastructure runs under an independent sovereign governance structure, operated exclusively by EU residents, transitioning to EU citizens, with no critical dependencies on non-EU infrastructure. The AWS European Sovereign Cloud delivers this control alongside the full breadth of AWS cloud capabilities, with the same security, availability, and performance as existing AWS Regions.

For Twinlink, this deployment is part of its technology resilience strategy, giving companies full disclosure on where their strategic data is stored. A highly regulated European company in financial services will be the first to use Twinlink's AI agents running on the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, keeping its data within the EU.

“European enterprises shouldn't have to choose between advanced AI and their resilience requirements. With our stack on the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, they won't have to anymore,” said Gautier Cloix, CEO of Twinlink.

“For us, digital sovereignty and AI sovereignty are one continuum, and both come down to giving customers more control and choice. With partners like Twinlink on the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, we want to help Europe's most innovative start-ups succeed and accelerate the digital transformation of highly regulated sectors," said Stéphane Israël, managing director of the AWS European Sovereign Cloud and Digital Sovereignty at AWS.

Amazon Web Services is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud, offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally. Millions of customers, including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies, are using AWS to lower costs, become more agile, and innovate faster. AWS launched the AWS European Sovereign Cloud in early 2026, backed by a €7.8 billion planned investment through 2040. Learn more at aws.amazon.com.

Founded in Paris, Twinlink is building a global AI leader that transforms how enterprises work by focusing on measurable business outcomes. The company's Holo models and multi-agent architecture enable enterprises to achieve strategic competitive advantages.

The latest model version, Holo4, leads computer use benchmarks, with much lower costs than general-purpose models. Twinlink serves Fortune 500 and CAC40 companies globally and investors include Accel, Eric Schmidt, Amazon, LVMH, Xavier Niel, Samsung, and UiPath. Learn more at hcompany.ai
